subject: general
question:
Five film makers, Pragati, Ratan, Tomar, Vihari and Ujwala, live on five different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it number 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 5. Vihari lives on the floor immediately below Ujwala. Pragati lives on the floor immediately above Tomar. Ratan lives on the floor immediately above Pragati. Ujwala lives on the floor immediately below Tomar.

Who lives on the third floor?
solution:

1) Pragati lives on the floor immediately above Tomar.

2) Ratan lives on the floor immediately above Pragati.
